move: three story cuts via clip-path, bars tick, sticker pops, white flash-cut
how: A 1080x1920 story: three full-bleed image frames, a header with avatar, three segment progress bars, two big uppercase words, an italic pill line, a yellow round sticker, a CTA and a white cutbar. Cut one: the first image drifts scale 1.15 to 1 with yPercent 3 to -3 (linear), the header drops in and the two words rise through masks (expo.out). At 30% the second frame reveals from clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) (expo.inOut, 0.45s) while the words slide out xPercent -110 and the italic pill rises un-rotating; the sticker pops from scale 0 rotate -40 (back.out(2)) and rocks. At 65% the third frame reveals from the bottom, the CTA rises and bobs. Each progress bar fills scaleX over its third of the duration. At 93% the white cutbar wipes across from the left (expo.in), flips origin and snaps away.
adapt: Swap the three images, handle, words, pill text, sticker and CTA; keep the thirds structure, the 0.45s expo.inOut clip reveals and the flash-cut at 93%.
port: mount(el, shot) builds frames, bars and text from shot; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with cuts at 0.3D and 0.65D, bars at D/3 each, cutbar at 0.93D. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: the cutbar retracts in the final 0.03s so the last frame shows frame three under a sliver of white
the filled progress bars and the third image scale jump back on loop, hidden only by the flash
